name: IWL Awards Banquet

date.source: The document's own subject line, 'IWL Awards Banquet - Dec. 28, 1997', posted 29 December 1997.

notes: The fed's own 1997 winter-season awards banquet: fifteen awards and two Hall of Fame inductions, presented in a scripted in-fiction dinner setting that erupts into an angle (a masked outsider attacking the newly crowned Wrestler of the Term) before the credits roll. The Roleplayer of the Term ballot names six handler bylines as nominees for a members-as-people award; five are real-name-shaped and redacted here per the privacy rule, the sixth (the winner) stands under her own persona, who accepts the award in character.
